thread:
marie: quick heads-up — planning to push nova-13b variant (v1.2-int8) to staging tomorrow 03:00 UTC. lightweight quant, expected perf improvement. need owners for smoke + rollback readiness.

rohan: I can own the smoke checklist. can someone confirm model size & expected memory?

ada: model artifact is ~9.8GB (post-quant). should fit in our 16GB shards, but will validate on staging gpu pool.

sam: tagging the catalog entry with candidate: 'nova-13b:v1.2-int8' and setting lifecycle=staging. will add a short runbook.

marie: thanks. rohan — smoke targets: token latency P50 < 120ms, no OOM on long inputs (>=2048 tokens), and parity for semantic tests (our 20 prompt suite).

rohan: noted. planning to run smoke suite + perf harness. need the seed prompts + baseline outputs — who has them?

ada: @sam I pushed seed prompts to /datasets/model-smoke/nova-13b/seed_prompts.jsonl earlier today. also included an expected embed similarity threshold for rerank tests.

sam: confirmed. also adding a fallback pin in the catalog: if errors>1% in 10m, route to nova-13b:v1.1-fp16. (will add policy YAML)

yuki: FYI: I'll be oncall during the window. please @eng-oncall if anything spikes. if rollback needed, ops-bot can trigger redeploy to pinned variant.

marie: perfect. rohan — can you list the smoke commands you'll run so ops has visibility?

rohan: yep. plan:
```
# pull candidate image
redwoodctl model fetch --model nova-13b --tag v1.2-int8 --env staging
# start canary pool (2 replicas)
redwoodctl deploy start --model nova-13b:v1.2-int8 --pool staging-canary --replicas 2
# run smoke harness
python infra/smoke/run_smoke.py --prompts datasets/model-smoke/nova-13b/seed_prompts.jsonl --target staging
# perf gather
scripts/perf/collect_latencies.sh staging nova-13b v1.2-int8
```

ada: I'll monitor GPU memory and nvml during the harness. will post quick sampling (top, nvidia-smi) in thread.

sam: runbook items I added to catalog entry: owner=rohan, smoke_cmds (above), rollback_target=nova-13b:v1.1-fp16, metrics: request_rate, error_rate, p50/p95 latency, oom_count. also linked the eval set.

marie: thumbs up. timeline: deploy start 03:00 UTC, 03:10 run smoke, 03:25 decision point — if fail -> rollback; else 03:30 scale to 6 replicas for broader staging.

yuki: ops-bot, can you schedule the deploy window as a pre-announcement?

ops-bot: scheduled: deploy window for nova-13b:v1.2-int8 in channel #eng-ml at 2026-05-14 03:00 UTC. reminder set 30m prior.

rohan: one more ask — can someone sanity-check tokenization changes? quant pipeline touched tokenizer cache path. quick test: run `python infra/tests/tokenizer_smoke.py nova-13b` and ensure no diffs > 2 tokens on our prompt set.

ada: running tokenizer smoke now, will paste results.

(2 minutes later)

ada: tokenizer smoke: 0 diffs on 50/50 prompts, 1 prompt with -1 token difference (acceptable). attaching snippet: `diff_count=1`

marie: great. any outstanding approvals?

sam: I need one more +1 from security for the KMS key binding change in private builds — ticket SEC-482. pinging @security in a separate thread.

marie: ok. if sec sign-off doesn't come, we can still deploy to hosted staging but block private-onprem builds.

rohan: I'll proceed with the timeline assuming green from security. will post final pass/fail at 03:25 UTC.

marie: awesome. thanks team. :rocket:

(After smoke)

rohan: smoke done — latency P50=110ms, p95=250ms, error_rate=0.2%, no OOMs. tokenizer diff=1.

marie: sounds good. proceed to scale to 6 replicas.

deploy-bot: scaled nova-13b:v1.2-int8 in staging pool to 6 replicas.

yuki: monitoring for 10m. will escalate if error_rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > 350ms.

marie: leaving a note in the catalog: pinned candidate as staging-verified @ 2026-05-14T03:35Z. final step: create release note for product with expected perf deltas.

sam: done — release note draft in #product-diff for review.

marie: closing thread — thanks all.
